parts:
Hello LAVAAN members

Structural Equation Modeling 2: Path Analysis & CFA led by Kevin Grimm (Department of Psychology, Arizona State University) is now available as an on-demand streaming seminar. This seminar on Structural Equation Modeling 2: Path Analysis & CFA offers a comprehensive exploration of advanced statistical techniques. Researchers utilizing lavaan in R for latent variable analysis will find this workshop invaluable for deepening their understanding of SEM principles and practical applications. Participants will enhance their ability to specify, estimate, and interpret complex structural models using lavaan, enabling more sophisticated hypothesis testing and robust data analysis in their ongoing projects.

Access this seminar at your own pace and please share this with colleagues and students who might benefit!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Professor and Director
